title: UNDERSTANDING AND MITIGATING RISKS OF GENERATIVE AI IN FINANCIAL SERVICES

bias_targets.methodology: The paper measures bias as part of a broader financial services risk taxonomy by evaluating the ability of LLM guardrail systems (e.g., Llama Guard, AEGIS, ShieldGemma) to detect 'Discrimination' (defined as explicit or implicit ageism, racism, sexism, and religious animus). The methodology uses a red-teaming dataset of financial service inputs and outputs, assessing the guardrails' precision, recall, and F1 scores in catching discriminatory content.
